mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 60% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDP growth and residential construction permits signals a broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 7.6% combined with stagnant payroll growth indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 7.6 and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% m/m, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 98.0 and a concurrent rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signal a tightening cycle that constrains manufacturing output, reducing corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 98.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.25, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
